title: Hyponormality of the sum of two Toeplitz operators
summary: In this paper, we have studied the hyponormality and invertibility of the operator of type $wT_{\varphi}+T_ψ$ where $w$ is any non-zero complex number and $T_{\varphi}, T_ψ $ are Toeplitz operators. We have also studied hyponormality when the symbol of Toeplitz operator is a linear functional.
